posts.author: SahilPatani
posts.text: JWL is a textbook cyclical pattern. Stock went all the way up to 750, management conveniently announced Capex, did a QIP at 660, Tatravagonka pumped in money at 480 and now the stock is back to its 3 year low. Even good news, order wins are not enough to reel the price up. It might still do well eventually but you have to laud the management for ensuring they do a capital raise at the absolute peak of the cycle.
